scope: Fourteen real Bevy menu captures on a private Weston display, using one final post-check.sh viewer binary. The checker requires complete route/train choices, both train headings, all country choices and persistent launch controls at the recorded resolutions/scales. Advanced screens retain scrolling. These are layout and launch-availability checks, not startup/frame-time benchmarks or a certification of every train and route.
